energy_cell.summary: 60-frame battery charge-level animation, previously hard-classified as UI-only. Equally usable as a world prop, pickup, or machine component -- the role depends on where it is placed, not on the art.

floor_hatch_grate.summary: 2x2 green-bordered floor hatch / grate panel. Whether it should be walkable, one-way, or purely decorative is a level-design call this table does not make.

floor_solid.summary: Flat 16px navy panel with no ornamentation; safe generic solid ground/wall block.

floor_wedge_ne.summary: 45-degree corner-cut ground tile, NE cell of the same matched 2x2 wedge set as floor_wedge_nw.

floor_wedge_nw.summary: 45-degree corner-cut ground tile, NW cell of a matched 2x2 wedge set. Confirm the exact slope direction visually before using it as a walkable ramp.

floor_wedge_se.summary: 45-degree corner-cut ground tile, SE cell of the same matched 2x2 wedge set as floor_wedge_nw.

floor_wedge_sw.summary: 45-degree corner-cut ground tile, SW cell of the same matched 2x2 wedge set as floor_wedge_nw.

hazard_laser_gate_double.summary: 4-cell vertical laser-hazard column with a taller double beam between cap and base.

hazard_laser_gate_thin.summary: 3-cell vertical laser-hazard column: emitter cap, single thin beam, emitter base.

hazard_laser_gate_wide.summary: 4-cell vertical laser-hazard column with a wide/pink beam variant of hazard_laser_gate_double.

hazard_spike_row.summary: Repeatable spike-hazard strip (white spikes on a dark base); variants continue through smafu_067-smafu_071.

hazard_stripe_marker.summary: Orange diagonal warning-stripe floor marking. This is a decorative caution marker, not itself a collision hazard -- pair it with a real hazard tile or a level edge.

pipe_column_reactor.summary: Vertical hazard-banded reactor conduit assembled from 4 stacked 32px segments; visually distinct from the plain repeatable pipe_v_mid segment.

pipe_v_mid.summary: Plain gray cylindrical pipe segment with no caps; repeat vertically for a pipe run of any height.

wall_panel_accent.summary: Flat violet accent-color panel, same silhouette as wall_panel_flat; use to break up large industrial surfaces.

wall_panel_flat.summary: Plain flat industrial wall/floor panel with no ornamentation; safe generic 32px solid block.

wall_panel_riveted_large.summary: 3x3 riveted wall section with a recessed bolted center; a large background/structural motif, not a single repeatable tile.

warning_light_strip.summary: Horizontal strip of red warning lights; decorative hazard marker drawn as one wide sprite.

purpose: Curated, human/agent-readable semantic roles for a subset of generated assets -- a design aid for SELECTING art. It never creates collision; semantic_tile_contract.json's level layer is the only thing allowed to do that.

schema.adjacency: socket -> list of semantic keys that tile naturally against it
schema.assembly: role -> asset key (or nested list of keys) for a multi-cell prop
schema.asset: a single raw tile/frame key, for a single-cell entry
schema.cell_size: [w, h] px of one cell in the assembly's native pack
schema.matched_set: sibling asset keys authored together as one visual set
schema.pack: which source pack (see source_signatures) the asset was drawn from
schema.semantic_support: solid | hazard | one_way | none | unassigned -- a HINT only; semantic_tile_contract.json's level layer is authoritative
schema.sockets: named connection points this entry exposes
schema.usage: intended roles; an asset may serve more than one
